deferrals.reason: electron-builder 26.18.0 is latest and still pins asar 3.4.1; asar and dir-compare call minimatch as a function, incompatible with minimatch 11's named exports. Legacy glob also relies on the old API. Only local packaging tools consume these patterns; no untrusted glob input is accepted by this fork. Modern consumers are overridden to the patched line. This is risk acceptance, not a claim that legacy versions are unaffected.
deferrals.reconsider: Re-review on the revisit date, any advisory range/severity or affected lock-node change, or an electron-builder/asar/glob/dir-compare release supporting patched minimatch; then verify Windows archive/filter and packaged installer behavior.
